'''Karani''', including the '''Koresh-e Rostam''' dialect, is a dialect of the [[Tati language (Iran)|Tati language.]]<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://glottolog.org/resource/languoid/id/kara1512|title=Karani|access-date=1 December 2025|website=Glottolog}}</ref> It is a [[language death|moribund]] [[Northwestern Iranian languages|Northwestern Iranian language]].<ref>{{e25}}</ref>
